Notes_and_Tips: Keep rice portions controlled but do not eliminate carbs completely.
Include vegetables in every meal to increase fibre intake.
For stress eating, pause and eat slowly.
Fried and spicy foods can increase cravings; keep them occasional.
Regular meal timing supports energy and digestion.
Focus on visible body changes and daily energy levels.
